claim: R2026b Wireless Testbench lists UHD 4.9.0.0; local skill instructions assuming 4.6 require revalidation.
X300/X310 daughterboard support differs: UBX160/OBX160/TwinRX support baseband capture; Other boards including UBX40/WBX/SBX/CBX have Live Data I/O only.
capture timestamp is the host capture-request datetime, not the hardware first-sample time. droppedSamples is a boolean status, not a lost-sample count.
Initial capture samples can include radio-path transients. UseRadioBuffer true and false select different integrity/throughput constraints.
UHD overflow behavior depends on device, transport and mode; the receive metadata reports the event. Continuing data does not prove sample continuity.
Common frequency reference, time alignment, timed DSP starts, and analog LO phase calibration address different synchronization requirements.
A receiver's 10 MHz/PPS synchronization does not lock an independent smartphone display oscillator; capture timing/CFO drift remains to be estimated.
A current probe around the relevant complete cable senses net current; ideal opposing normal-mode currents cancel. Probe scope and enclosed return/shield paths matter.
Measurement path mismatch and frequency-dependent CMRR create errors; matched probes and symmetric connections are required for mode measurements.
An antenna IQ mixture plus low rank is insufficient to identify DSI common mode; calibrated electrical-mode measurements and spatial/control experiments are needed.
RawFile casts int16 in host byte order and sends alternating scalar I/Q values. Windows playback requires a separate little-endian copy of the documented big-endian RIS.
RawFile ENABLE_LOOP=1 rewinds at EOF, and callback reports drop=0; replay count is not independent frame count and original acquisition loss is unknown.

RawFile's partial EOF read can leave the rest of a fixed-size callback buffer stale/uninitialized. Use complete scalar block exports and exclude replay boundaries; runtime DLL/source identity remains unverified.
One sc16 complex stream needs 32*Fs bit/s payload. A 1Gb/s link has an ideal ceiling of 31.25MS/s before overhead, below all four existing reference file sample rates.
Small sinusoidal AM index 0.01 produces each first-order sideband at 10log10(0.01^2/4)=-46.0206dBc. Small PM beta=0.01rad has the same first-order result; this is not measured device modulation.
The antenna files have no embedded Fs. The smartphone rate/BW/fc values in DATASETS.md are external metadata, mostly filenames; actual receiver readback and BW definition are unavailable.
Use fixed-duration untriggered captures initially. An energy trigger may select strong clutter rather than weak screen-correlated modulation; establish detection bias before using it.

Compare calibrated CM/DM channels, current-probe observations and antenna IQ under controlled pattern/position/brightness changes; a stripe or its low-confidence phase alone does not identify a column driver.
exportRisForTempest default 2^20 complex samples is 7.68ms at LG rate, 19.05ms at iPhone6s rate, and 9.46ms at Galaxy111.9 rate; these are too short for multi-frame averaging.
